scientific_decision: Use validation aligned to geographic transfer and dependence
paper_implementation: Reviewed cross-validation strategies for structured data and recommended blocking when observations are dependent
repository_implementation: Freeze geographic transferability as later estimand and exclude random pixel CV
adaptation: No folds constructed in 5A

scientific_decision: Characterize autocorrelation before model fitting with raw target variograms
paper_implementation: blockCV autocorrelation workflow samples raster locations (5000 by default) and fits isotropic variograms; raw response is discussed as a pre-model option
repository_implementation: Sample 5000 locations per target support and estimate isotropic raw-response variograms
adaptation: Three support-specific samples; strict FLPs share locations

scientific_decision: Keep range measurement separate from fold geometry
paper_implementation: Measured response spatial autocorrelation with an empirical semivariogram then built spatial validation units slightly larger than that range
repository_implementation: Measure target dependence only
adaptation: No clustering or spatial unit scale selected

scientific_decision: Use Matheron empirical semivariance and effective range from Python implementation
paper_implementation: Presented SciKit-GStat empirical estimators theoretical fits and effective-range parameterization
repository_implementation: Use SciKit-GStat Matheron Euclidean isotropic variograms and report effective ranges
adaptation: Use canonical EPSG:5070 meters and raw targets

scientific_decision: Select theoretical family by weighted residual sum of squares
paper_implementation: Described automatic variogram fitting used by automap with candidate models and residual-based selection
repository_implementation: Fit spherical exponential Gaussian and Matérn with free nugget and select minimum N/h² weighted SSE
adaptation: Matérn is a SciKit family analogue of automap Stein and fit uses upper lag boundaries

scientific_decision: Use separate spatial tuning and assessment loops later
paper_implementation: Compared nested spatial cross-validation approaches for hyperparameter tuning and performance assessment
repository_implementation: Record later need for separate spatial loops
adaptation: No nested CV implemented in 5A

scientific_decision: Do not interpret spatial CV as design-unbiased fixed-map accuracy
paper_implementation: Distinguished spatial cross-validation from design-based map accuracy assessment
repository_implementation: Constrain future interpretation to geographic transferability
adaptation: No model performance estimate in 5A

scientific_decision: Map canonical target names to analysis aliases
paper_implementation: Stored physical target columns as BP and FLP1 through FLP6
repository_implementation: Read physical columns and expose lowercase bp and flp1 through flp6 in analysis outputs
adaptation: User approved read-time aliases; no canonical modification or value conversion

scientific_decision: Use automap nonuniform sample-bounding-box lag boundaries
citation: Valavi et al. (2019) and automap autofitVariogram source
paper_implementation: Automap scales twelve uneven lag boundaries to 35 percent of projected input bounding-box diagonal
repository_implementation: Derive the same twelve boundaries separately from each frozen 5000-cell sample
adaptation: Run 1 full-extent equal-width bins are superseded

scientific_decision: Merge undersupported short-distance bins
paper_implementation: Default merge.small.bins is true with min.np.bin equal to five and earliest boundary removed until retained bins meet threshold
repository_implementation: Use five-pair minimum and recompute empirical bins after dropping first boundary
adaptation: No observation creation or semivariance interpolation

scientific_decision: Use distance-sensitive weighted fitting
citation: Hiemstra et al. (2009) and automap/gstat fitting procedure
paper_implementation: Automatic theoretical fits use distance-sensitive residual criterion and select lowest fitted SSE
repository_implementation: Set SciKit fitting sigma proportional to mean lag distance divided by square root of pair count; select minimum N/h squared weighted SSE
adaptation: SciKit fits at upper lag boundaries while automap uses empirical mean distances

scientific_decision: Report effective range only with supported sill
paper_implementation: SciKit-GStat parameterizes models by effective range and supports nugget plus partial sill
repository_implementation: Report nugget partial sill total sill ratio and conservative resolved-range diagnostic
adaptation: The empirical support and tail-fit checks are repository diagnostics not a source-defined threshold

scientific_decision: Keep first run as superseded provenance
paper_implementation: HITL rejected full-extent first-bin resolution and stable-for-Stein interpretation
repository_implementation: Archive Run 1 diagnostics and use Run 2 for range inference
adaptation: Three sampled Parquet inputs remain byte-identical

scientific_decision: Freeze accepted target-specific Run 2 range findings
paper_implementation: Not a literature claim; Run 2 fits and empirical lag support are retained in the report tables
repository_implementation: Accept BP 211.151 km FLP2 173.810 km and unconditional FLEP8 82.059 km with weaker unweighted fit; six other targets remain RANGE_UNRESOLVED
adaptation: No universal target-derived range follows from the multi-output results

scientific_decision: Do not treat variogram nugget as model aleatoric uncertainty
paper_implementation: Reports the nugget as a component of the spatial variogram model
repository_implementation: Report raw-target nugget within each selected variogram fit
adaptation: No fitted predictive model or aleatoric decomposition exists in 5A

scientific_decision: Determine spatial quantity governing validation separation
citation: Roberts et al. (2017) and Ploton et al. (2020)
paper_implementation: Discuss dependence-aware validation and give a response-range-based mapping example
repository_implementation: Defer whether BP predictors residuals or another literature-backed quantity governs scale
adaptation: Target-specific ranges do not imply a universal multi-output validation separation

scientific_decision: Choose block cluster or buffered validation geometry
citation: Roberts et al. (2017) and Ploton et al. (2020)
paper_implementation: Discuss structured resampling and give one clustered large-scale mapping example
repository_implementation: No validation geometry or buffer distance chosen
adaptation: Geometry and separation require later HITL review

scientific_decision: Choose outer fold count and fold allocation
paper_implementation: Reviewed spatially structured cross-validation designs and their prediction-task dependence
repository_implementation: No outer folds or allocation selected
adaptation: Cannot infer fold count or allocation from target variograms alone

scientific_decision: Specify inner spatial resampling for tuning
paper_implementation: Compared nested spatial cross-validation for tuning and final performance estimation
repository_implementation: No inner fold count allocation or tuning loop selected
adaptation: Implementation remains a later HITL decision

scientific_decision: Choose any final train validation test proportions
paper_implementation: Related validation structure to intended prediction task and dependence
repository_implementation: No proportions or split selected
adaptation: Proportions are not determined by the variogram analysis
